subject: Any later observation used to assess second orders should be consented, and assessment should occur once the relevant cohorts have actually completed eight weeks.
rationale: The rule prospectively governs later second-order assessment: use consented observations and defer assessment until the relevant cohorts complete eight weeks. These eligibility and timing requirements provide sufficiently determinate triggers and responses and are internally coherent. Uncertain availability of later observations does not undermine the rule's structure or establish that assessment has occurred.
